application: controler_mise_en_forme v2 and harmoniser_mise_en_forme v2 (adopted); docx_couches v3 and evaluer_travail v8 (D3 also rejects tracked formatting); moteur_revision_multi v3 to be prepared.
controle: controler_mise_en_forme comparer --auteur; check against the accepted view (real acceptance); evaluer_travail D3
regle: After each revision pass: controler_mise_en_forme comparer <avant> <après> --auteur <passe> (code 1 = pass rejected). An inserted passage takes on the properties of its neighbour; emptying a paragraph deletes its mark and aligns its properties with the next paragraph; emptying a table deletes its rows; agent text is cleaned of Markdown. Before delivery: comparison of the accepted view with a real acceptance.
source: Report v6.0.5-rev1: 4 headings that became body text on acceptance, 65 empty lines or bullets, 26 passages in 12 pt in an 11 pt body, 3 orphaned fragments, 2 emptied tables whose grid remained. The engine inserted passages without properties and deleted text without deleting the structures (paragraph mark, rows, caption).
titre: Check the accepted view of every pass: formatting included
